aboutDetail: I'm a Computer Science student who's always been fascinated by how ideas turn into innovation through code. What started as simple curiosity about how things work has grown into a passion for building smart, reliable, and meaningful technology. I've worked across different domains - from developing enterprise solutions to exploring data and cloud ecosystems - and what drives me most is solving real-world problems with creativity and precision. I love connecting logic with design, data with purpose, and technology with human impact. I believe learning never really stops - every new project, challenge, or line of code is a chance to grow, collaborate, and create something better than before.
